name.ja: Figure-rise Standard 超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人ベジット
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Vegetto

description.ja: 悟空とベジータがポタラで合体し、超サイヤ人ゴッド超サイヤ人ベジットに変身した姿をFigure-rise Standardで立体化！
description.en: Goku and Vegeta combine in the Potara and transform into Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Vegito, now in Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: • 顔の表情は「平常」「叫び」の２種が付属。
description.en: • Two types of facial expressions are included: "normal " and " screaming".

description.ja: • 連結可能なベジットソードエフェクトが付属。
description.en: • A connectable Vegito sword effect is included.

accessories.ja: 表情パーツ2種（平常、叫び）×各1
accessories.en: 2 types of facial expression parts (normal, screaming) x 1 each
7 types of wrist parts x 1 each
